question:
Solve the following:

523 + 523 × 523 ÷ 523
solution:
Concept used:

BODMAS Rule:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/325e61034daca157ac44fd0ffb7f2a56a065b9f30c8d2593051ad1c92dbb53d8.png] 

Calculation:

523 + 523 × 523 ÷ 523

⇒ 523 + 523 × 1

⇒ 523 + 523

⇒ 1046

∴ The simplified value** is 1046.**
